surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient transitions between the primary dark-grey canvas and lighter mottled regions are diffuse and lack sharp demarcation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A distinct, elevated longitudinal ridge is visible along the central axis; no traumatic depressions or unnatural geometric deformations are detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible small, white circular depigmented marks/spots on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible as a singular, high-contrast dark circular aperture located at the anterior dorsal apex.
